# ObGetCleanCanBeUsed

<Badge type="warning" text="warning" /> <Badge type="tip" text="on by default" /> <Badge type="tip" text="quick-fix" /> 

Group: [Control flow](/rules/#control-flow) · PhpStorm name: `ObGetCleanCanBeUsedInspection`

Reading the output buffer with `ob_get_contents()` and then discarding it with
`ob_end_clean()` in the next statement is exactly what the single built-in
`ob_get_clean()` does. Merge the two calls.

## Example

::: code-group

```php{5,10} [Before]
<?php
function renderPanel($tpl) {
    ob_start();
    include $tpl;
    $markup = ob_get_contents();
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    show_footer();
    $size = strlen(\ob_get_contents());
    // drop the buffer
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    echo ob_get_contents();
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    $copy = ob_get_contents();
    flush_logs();
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    $last = ob_get_contents();
    $ok = ob_end_clean();

    return [$markup, $size, $copy, $last, $ok];
}
```

```php [After fix]
<?php
function renderPanel($tpl) {
    ob_start();
    include $tpl;
    $markup = ob_get_clean();

    ob_start();
    show_footer();
    $size = strlen(\ob_get_clean());
    // drop the buffer

    ob_start();
    echo ob_get_contents();
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    $copy = ob_get_contents();
    flush_logs();
    ob_end_clean();

    ob_start();
    $last = ob_get_contents();
    $ok = ob_end_clean();

    return [$markup, $size, $copy, $last, $ok];
}
```

:::

Reported:

<ul>
<li>line 5: Use ob_get_clean() instead of ob_get_contents() + ob_end_clean().</li>
<li>line 10: Use ob_get_clean() instead of ob_get_contents() + ob_end_clean().</li>
</ul>

## Configure

In [`custos.json`](/guide/configuration):

```json
{
  "rules": {
    "ObGetCleanCanBeUsed": {
      "enabled": false
    }
  }
}
```

## Suppress

Before the statement or declaration (or the first statement of the file), either of:

```php
// @custos-ignore ObGetCleanCanBeUsed

/**
 * @noinspection ObGetCleanCanBeUsedInspection
 */
```
